newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek firms should revalue real estate by end-96.
newsitem.headline: Greek firms should revalue real estate by end-96.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry presented a draft bill to parliament on Friday that makes it mandatory for firms to revalue their real estate holdings by year-end. The bill deals mainly with modifications of Greece's customs code.
The bill sets a five percent tax rate for land and an eight percent rate for buildings.

The draft bill is for modification of the customs code and makes it possible for individuals and firms to repay their back debts to the state in the form of 24 monthly instalments. Soccer clubs will be able to do so in 90 monthly instalments.
The draft bill provides for an increase in car registration fees in 1997 and stiffer penalties for smuggling fuels, tobacco and liquor.
